table_introduction_event.message: Generate tabulated EOSs with lal TOV solver
table_introduction_event.apr4_table_status: added in this commit with the same Git blob SHA-1 as the later pinned source

uv_lock_at_introduction.interpretation: The 7.26.4 lock resolution was present in the same repository commit that introduced APR4_EPP.npz; this narrows provenance but does not prove the lock was used for generation.

generator_method.baryon_density_interpretation: The committed n column is explicitly a rest-mass approximation, not the native LAL baryon density and not a first-law-consistent n(P) reconstruction. Its shape discrepancy is therefore an intentional generator convention, not evidence that the APR4 epsilon/pressure/enthalpy columns were corrupted.

dependency_lineage.reason: The 7.26.4 lock existed at table introduction, but the documented generator command is uv pip install -e .[dev] and pyproject declares unversioned lalsuite. No generating environment/build log proves that the lock resolution was installed; the exact runtime binary remains unknown.

physical_gates.original_apr4_table_causality: FAIL_SOURCE_TABLE_HAS_SUPERLUMINAL_HIGH_DENSITY_SEGMENT; retain original result and do not conflate with causal-cut candidate

scope: Pinned public source metadata and generator implementation were audited; no EOS table was regenerated, no RNS/TOV solve was repeated, and no physical normalization or EOS posterior is claimed.
